findings.title: The quote panel has no clear edge

location.description: The sample quote on the right of the hero.

findings.viewer_experience: The panel runs into the page background, so a visitor cannot tell at once where the sample quote begins and where the page text ends.

current.value: A panel with almost the same colour as the page and no outline.

findings.target: The panel reads as its own object, separate from the page.
findings.fix_direction: Give the panel a surface or edge that sets it apart from the page.
findings.source: Müller-Brockmann, Grid Systems in Graphic Design (figure and ground)

closed_when.check: Looking at the hero, the quote panel is clearly separate from the page background.

findings.title: The three notes below the hero have little order

location.description: The row of three notes under the divider.

findings.viewer_experience: A tiler skims the row and finds no point to start from.

current.value: Titles and text close in weight and size.

findings.target: The title of each note is easy to find.
findings.fix_direction: Give each title more weight than its text.

closed_when.check: Looking at the row, each title is clearly stronger than its text.
